basis: docs/design/RMUC2027_UAV_V2_2.md#7.7 地图和视觉区域定位输出

upstream_observation.source: front_rgb observation from the existing v2 sensor/observation contract

visual_perception_output.landmark_identity: proposed landmark_id/class; current asset landmark is RMUC2027 central tower
visual_perception_output.stable_reference_point: green roof-light keypoint in image pixels; UNAVAILABLE if not observable
visual_perception_output.image_bearing: horizontal image angle atan2(keypoint_x - cx0, fx), radians
visual_perception_output.mask: not required by the current V2.2 consumer
visual_perception_output.confidence: score/quality with explicit definition, not a calibrated probability unless calibrated

association_consumer.purpose: update visible landmark hypotheses/region candidates and conservative coarse bearing; retain multiple hypotheses; no direct setpoint
must_not: treat bbox center as a stable physical anchor
treat image bearing as world bearing
treat absence as proof no landmark exists
output world position or distance without geometry/calibration

allowed: bounded heading/search action after separate control validation

answers.why_identity: region/landmark relay needs to associate a detection with a known landmark/region; false match is more dangerous than miss
answers.stable_physical_reference: green roof-light center when visible; otherwise no anchor and reject/UNKNOWN
answers.image_bearing_or_world_bearing: image bearing only from perception; world bearing requires external attitude/map transform and is outside this consumer
answers.bbox_consumed: auxiliary only for detection quality/visibility/gating; downstream landmark relay consumes identity/visibility/bearing
answers.mask_reason: no current downstream consumer requires a mask; segmentation adds annotation/compute cost without a defined decision

proposed_output_record.score_definition: explicitly named; not probability unless calibrated

guardrails: no region/world/localization/distance conclusion from this output
invalid data must carry explicit reason, never zero placeholder
do not use image bearing for horizontal translation without separately validated control conditions
landmark absence is not proof of target absence
